comparison.objective: Lock hand-held pliers onto a marked section of tube.
comparison.physical_skill: Place jaws and squeeze handles past a latch point without displacing the tool.
comparison.success_condition: Pliers remain independently clamped, level, on the marked band after release.
comparison.reason: Tests over-centre/latching clamp closure and self-retention. It has no impact, sacrificial fracture, insert-retention constraint, or fragment collection.
